public_rationale: Observer’s September 28, 2024 report documents a substantial group of senior OpenAI departures during 2024, including Karpathy, Sutskever, Schulman and Murati, as well as Leike, Deng, McGrew and Zoph [e1]. Excluding Brockman’s temporary leave, these departures support the cumulative claim that many top people had left before March 1, 2025 [e1].
limitations: The evidence relies on one news report and does not provide a complete count of senior departures.
The report identifies Amodei as a former employee but does not establish his departure date or seniority in the supplied evidence.
The departures alone do not establish their effect on OpenAI’s performance or prospects.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Many top people have left OpenAI.

statement.excerpt: Many many top people have left (Sutskever, Murati, Schulman, recently, Amodei and Karpathy before, etc and many, many more).

from_speaker: Many many top people have left
our_interpretation: Top people means founders, senior executives, and leaders of major research or product functions.
The wording describes accumulated departures before publication, including earlier departures, rather than departures within a single quarter.
Many is assessed against the named examples and additional senior departures, without inventing a precise numerical threshold.
Temporary leave is not counted as a departure.
criteria.support_condition: Public records confirm multiple named senior departures and additional senior departures before March 1, 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The named examples are substantially incorrect, or the record shows only isolated departures rather than a substantial group of senior personnel.
